g.text: Emraan Hashmi’s Musical Horror Film ‘Rooh’ Adds Tips Films and Tips Music (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Melanie Lynskey Dispels ‘Two and a Half Men’ Pay Rumors: ‘There Is This Insane Idea That I Made Millions of Dollars’ ◆ Jon Stewart Slams Haley Stevens’ Mike Rogers Endorsement Ahead of Election Day ◆ Disney Expected to Lay Off Thousands of Staffers in Biggest Round of Cuts This Year ◆ ‘Tetsuo’ Director Tsukamoto Shinya on Staying Independent and Why He Can’t Pull Away From War Films ◆ Elena Maganini, Film Editor on ‘Dexter,’ ‘Henry, Portrait of a Serial Killer,’ Dies at 70 ◆
